Percentage change in Alarm.com's adjusted EBITDA from 2018 to 2019:

Given:
- 2018 adjusted EBITDA = $93,081 thousand
- 2019 adjusted EBITDA = $108,307 thousand

Formula for percentage change:
((New value - Old value) / Old value) × 100

Calculation:
((108,307 - 93,081) / 93,081) × 100
= (15,226 / 93,081) × 100
